description: Extracts text from a PDF file stored in S3, producing one row per page. Downloads PDF bytes and parses with pypdf. Filters out near-blank pages shorter than min_page_length characters. The input dataset is ignored — this profile operates entirely from the source_uri parameter. Typical use: ingest policy documents, grant proposals, accreditation reports, or research papers for downstream topic modeling or sentiment analysis.

source_uri.description: S3 URI of the PDF file to extract (s3://bucket/key.pdf)

include_page_numbers.description: Include a page_number column in the output (default true)

min_page_length.description: Minimum character count per page to include; pages shorter than this are filtered (default 50)
